title: Entity-Assembly Hash Envy
pattern: An external service or helper compiles a hash map or configuration dictionary of another object's internal properties.
why_bad: The assembling logic is tightly coupled to the entity's attributes. Any additions of parts/properties require updating this assembler. The creation of this structure belongs directly in the entity.
detection: A method that populates a generic data structure (like a `HashMap` or `Vec`) solely with properties extracted from a single foreign struct.
counterexample: A generic JSON serializer that automatically handles arbitrary types via reflection.
